import.q: How do I import a CSV file?
import.a: From the dashboard, drag and drop your CSV into the import zone or click to select it. Analysis starts automatically and feeds all charts and tables.

risk.q: How do I read the risk score?
risk.a: The score (0–100) aggregates detected signals: Benford's law, statistical outliers, duplications, etc. ≥ 70 = critical (red), 40–69 = suspect (orange), < 40 = review or compliant (green).

anomalies.a: Each anomaly maps to an analytical rule: Benford (digit distribution), outlier (atypical amount), duplication (double payment), etc. See transaction detail for the exact reason.
